saw_lines: People choosing a laser clinic weigh the doctor and device, then book one visit they trust before committing to a course.
So the trust must show in the first line, because a viewer who scrolls past never reaches the doctor’s credentials.
Your 17 copy ads carry no proof number. Collect one real figure, like your review count, and open three new ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 0 of 17 ads carry a proof number, so a new patient has little reason to trust the clinic before the click. Collect one real figure like your review count and open three new ads with it on the creative.

13 of 17 ads are creator style posts run from your brand page, so the buyer hears a sponsored voice, not the clinic. Whitelist those posts from the creator accounts, then cut three variations of the best of them.
5 of 17 ads open on the same lider line, so five ads fight for the same viewers and the rest go untested. Test two new openers, one on the first visit and one on a session, against that line.
0 of 17 ads carry an offer, so a first-time patient has no reason to book now. Give patients one reason to act, such as a first visit offer or a bundle of sessions, and lead three new ads with it.

ads_1: Creator stories with one proof number, tested against the lider opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
